name: moe_mixtral_8x7b
note: logical warp 8, 4 rows per hardware warp. k 2 is a final-evaluation column only (decision 2). Also bf16.

name: moe_dbrx
note: logical warp 16, 2 rows per warp. Also bf16.

name: moe_gpt_oss_20b
note: one row per logical warp of 32 with 1 item per lane, or 4 rows per warp at logical warp 8 with 4 items per lane. Also fp32.

name: moe_step3_padded
model_or_system: Step-3 (48 routed experts, top 3, config stepfun-ai/step3)
note: padded form of the real cell N 48 k 3: 16 of the 64 slots are padding filled with minus infinity, as a real kernel would do, and k 3 rounds to the k 4 column. The harness runs only N that are multiples of the thread count, partial tiles are outside the adapter contract. 2 items per lane. Also bf16.

name: moe_ernie45
note: 2 items per lane. Also bf16.

name: moe_qwen3_128
note: 4 items per lane. Run k 4 as well for gpt-oss-120b. Also fp32. Sub-warp variant: logical warp 8 with 16 items per lane, 4 rows per warp.

name: moe_glm45
note: non power of two N, pad to 256 or run as 5 items per lane with valid_items 160.

name: moe_deepseek_v3_256
model_or_system: DeepSeek-V3, R1, V3.2-Exp (after group masking), MiniMax-M2, Ling-1T, DeepSeek-V4-Flash (k 6)
note: 8 items per lane. sigmoid affinities in fp32. Also bf16. Run k 6 rounded to 8.

name: deepseek_v3_group_top2
note: top 2 within each of 8 groups of 32 experts, group score is the sum of the two. One group per register of a warp, 8 groups at once. k 2 column.

name: deepseek_v3_group_select
note: top 4 of 8 group scores, logical warp 8, 1 item per lane.

name: deepseek_v3_final_top8
note: top 8 over the 128 experts of the 4 kept groups, run as N 256 with 128 masked to minus infinity or as N 128 after compaction.

name: moe_kimi_k2_384
note: non power of two, 12 items per lane with valid_items 384 or pad to 512. Also fp32.

name: moe_qwen35_512_top10
note: 16 items per lane, k 10 rounds to the k 16 column. Also fp32.

name: moe_nemotron3_ultra_512_top22
note: k 22 rounds to the k 32 column. Also fp32.

name: moe_longcat_768_top12
note: 24 items per lane with valid_items 768 or pad to 1024, k 12 rounds to 16.

name: moe_kimi_k3_896_top16
note: 28 items per lane with valid_items 896 or pad to 1024. Also fp32. The largest current router.

name: peer_subkey_top16
note: twice per head (two sub-key sets), 8 heads per token, 32 items per lane.

name: peer_candidate_top16
note: top 16 over the 16 by 16 candidate sums, 8 items per lane.

name: ec_e64_c2
model_or_system: Expert-choice routing, 64 experts, capacity factor 2, 4096 tokens
note: k over N is c over E. One expert column per block, 64 columns per layer. Also bf16.

name: ec_e128_c1
model_or_system: Expert-choice routing, 128 experts, capacity factor 1, 4096 tokens
note: k over N 1 over 128.

name: mod_12p5_4096
note: k over N 1 over 8 at sequence length 4096, every other block. Also N 8192 k 1024.

name: sampling_chunk_32k_k64
model_or_system: Top-k and top-p sampling over a 128K to 262K vocabulary, chunk of 32768 per block
note: k 20 (Qwen3 default) to 50 (Transformers default) rounds to 32 or 64, run k 32 and 128 too. Exceeds one block: 4 to 8 chunks, then the merge cell. Latency at decode, throughput at large batch.

name: sampling_chunk_4k_k64
model_or_system: Sampling with small chunks, 4096 per block
note: 32 to 64 chunks per vocabulary, then a merge over 2048 to 4096 candidates with k 64.

name: sampling_merge_m8_k64
model_or_system: Merge of 8 chunk results for sampling
note: k over N 1 over 8. Inputs may arrive sorted (W1, N2, B6) which enables a k-truncated multiway merge.

name: beam_search_chunk
model_or_system: Beam search, 4 to 8 beams, 2 times beams candidates
note: beams times vocab scores chunked by 32768, k 8 to 16, then a merge of M 16. Deterministic tie-break is expected by users of beam search.

name: eagle2_children_top10
model_or_system: EAGLE-2 draft tree, select 10 of 100 children
note: 100 children padded to 128, k 10 rounds to 16. Per expansion step, depth 6.

name: eagle2_rerank_top60
model_or_system: EAGLE-2 draft tree rerank, 60 of about 600 nodes
note: about 600 nodes padded to 1024, k 60 rounds to 64. Total draft tokens 60, 50, 48 for 7B, 13B, 70B targets.

name: eagle_vocab_topk_sglang
model_or_system: EAGLE expansion over the vocabulary, SGLang default top-k 4
note: chunk of a 128K to 262K vocabulary, k 4 (SGLang Llama default) to 10 (EAGLE-2 paper), then a merge of M 4 to 8 with k 4 to 16.

name: dsa_v32_chunk_32k_k2048
model_or_system: DeepSeek-V3.2 DSA indexer, 128K context, chunk of 32768
note: 4 chunks per query at 128K, then dsa_v32_merge. Production has a deterministic variant, so both requirements. k over N 1 over 16.

name: dsa_v32_merge_m4_k2048
model_or_system: DeepSeek-V3.2 DSA merge of 4 chunk results
note: k over N 1 over 4, the large k regime where B1 and B6 compete, W4 and B6 explore the sorted-input merge.

name: dsa_v4_pro_chunk_32k_k1024
model_or_system: DeepSeek-V4-Pro DSA on compressed KV (1M context over 4), chunk of 32768
note: 8 chunks per query at 1M compressed by 4 (262144 entries), then merge N 8192 k 1024.

name: dsa_v4_flash_chunk_32k_k512
note: merge N 4096 k 512 for 8 chunks. GVR in TensorRT-LLM supports index_topk 512, 1024, 2048 on SM100 and above.

name: dsa_v4_merge_m8_k1024
model_or_system: DeepSeek-V4-Pro DSA merge of 8 chunk results
note: k over N 1 over 8.

name: dsa_small_context_8k_k2048
model_or_system: DeepSeek-V3.2 DSA at 8K context (one block holds the row)
note: short contexts put the whole row in one block with k over N 1 over 4.

name: nsa_blocks_32k
model_or_system: Native Sparse Attention, 32K context, 64-token selection blocks
note: 16 selected blocks including 1 initial and 2 local fixed blocks, implementations run top 16 and mask. 16 items per lane.

name: nsa_blocks_128k
note: 64 items per lane, or one block of 256 with 8 items per thread. Run both scopes.

name: moba_32k_b512_top3
note: k 3 rounds to 4. 64 blocks at 32K, logical warp 16 with 4 items per lane or a full warp with 2.

name: moba_1m_b4096_top12
note: k 12 rounds to 16, 8 items per lane.

name: quest_pages_32k_budget2048
note: k over N 1 over 16, 8 items per thread. Also as a warp cell with 64 items per lane.

name: quest_pages_128k_budget4096
note: k over N 1 over 32. Budget 256 tokens gives k 16 at the same N.

name: snapkv_16k_budget4096
model_or_system: SnapKV, 16K prompt, 4096 budget, pooled attention sums per head
note: k over N 1 over 4, per head. Budgets 1024 and 2048 give k over N 1 over 16 and 1 over 8.

name: snapkv_32k_budget1024
note: k over N 1 over 32.

name: h2o_cache_4096_20pct
model_or_system: H2O heavy-hitter eviction, 4096 cache positions, 20 percent
note: 20 percent is k 819, rounded to the k 1024 column (1 over 4). Also N 16384 k 4096.
